prompt:
Requested aspect ratio: 9:16. Render a complete 100% full-bleed vertical 9:16 2D endcard illustration extending continuously to all four edges with zero letterbox bars, zero subtitle boxes, and zero dark vignette.

Visual Style (ch_noir_dossier): 2D noir graphic-novel illustration: heavy black ink shapes and crisp linework with high-contrast flat shadows, limited palette of ink black (#111111), aged off-white paper (#E8E2D0), slate grey (#5A5F66) and a single accent of evidence red (#C0392B); case-file props such as folders, stamped documents, map pins and old photographs drawn flat; orthographic 2D, no gore, no blood, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D. Palette: #111111, #E8E2D0, #5A5F66, #C0392B.

Character Cast: Silhouette-style figures with simple faces, the narrator detective drawn as a faceless figure in a long coat and hat seen from behind or in profile. Outfit: Flat slate-grey long coat and hat; only evidence objects use the red accent.

Scene Composition: The channel character stands centered in the frame, pointing upwards with a welcoming smile. Clean, minimalist composition with at least 60% open negative space on the solid flat background.

Emphasis lettering instruction: render exact uppercase Vietnamese hand-lettered text in the upper third integrated directly onto the flat canvas (strictly zero rectangular text cards, banners, or gradient overlays covering artwork): "BẢN ĐẦY ĐỦ TRÊN YOUTUBE" and "HỒ SƠ KỲ LẠ".
